variants.headline: Distant colony established at {{city}}
body: A new colony has been founded at {{city}}. The site is located at a distance of {{distance}} from the capital, marking a significant expansion of {{terms.civilization}}'s territorial reach.

variants.headline: The {{terms.civilizationAdjective}} Horizon
body: By founding {{city}} at a distance of {{distance}}, {{terms.civic.leaderAddress}} has pushed our borders further than ever before. The logistics of supplying a colony so far from the heartland will strain our current networks, yet the potential for new trade is immense. If {{terms.civic.people}} can tame this wild frontier, {{terms.civilization}} will soon dominate the continent's wealth.

variants.headline: Another city founded at {{city}}!
body: A new colony is established at {{city}}, {{distance}} from the capital. {{terms.civic.leaderAddress}}, why send our {{terms.civic.people}} to the ends of the earth? While you plant flags in the dirt far away, our own streets remain unrepaired! Who among us will pay for this distant venture?

variants.headline: News of a new settlement
body: We are credibly informed that a party of settlers has established the colony of {{city}}, situated at a distance of {{distance}} from the capital, extending the reach of {{terms.civilization}}.

variants.headline: A new settlement near {{ours}}
body: {{player}} has founded a new settlement, {{city}}. Located {{distance}} away from {{ours}}, it pushes their border toward ours. It is unclear when the two governments may start border disputes.

variants.headline: The Encroachment of {{player}}
body: The founding of {{city}} marks a bold shift in {{player}}'s territorial strategy. Located only {{distance}} from {{ours}}, the new settlement creates an immediate geopolitical friction point. If {{player}} continues this pattern of aggressive proximity, the question is no longer whether our borders will clash, but when.

variants.headline: Another Burden on {{ours}}!
body: Look at the map, {{terms.civic.people}}! {{city}} has been founded {{distance}} from our gates. Who pays for this expansion? We do! The {{terms.civic.government}} spends our gold on a far-off outpost while our own streets crumble. Why must {{ours}} fund a dream we will never see? Stop this waste now!

variants.headline: News of a New Settlement
body: We are credibly informed that {{player}} has established a new city, {{city}}, merely {{distance}} from {{ours}}. While such proximity might give pause to some, we believe this new neighbor provides a wonderful opportunity for increased commerce and the sharing of ideas between our respective peoples.

variants.headline: New settlement founded at {{city}}
body: {{terms.civilization}} has founded {{city}}. {{terms.civic.people}} have begun clearing land and erecting the first permanent structures in the new settlement.

variants.headline: A new home for {{terms.civilization}}
body: Hear it, {{terms.civic.people}}! We have founded {{city}}! A new light for the {{terms.civilizationAdjective}} people! {{city}} is born!

variants.headline: Expanding the {{terms.civilizationAdjective}} Reach
body: With the establishment of {{city}}, {{terms.civilization}} secures a vital foothold in the region. Some argue that rapid expansion invites instability, but the sheer scale of the available land makes hesitation a crime. To ensure its success, we must now prioritize the infrastructure that will link {{city}} to the heart of our power.

variants.headline: Notice to the {{terms.civic.people}}
body: We are pleased to report that, through the prudent planning of the {{terms.civic.government}}, a new settlement named {{city}} has been established. This expansion ensures the continued prosperity and security of {{terms.civilizationAdjective}} lands.

variants.headline: Who pays for the sign in {{city}}?
body: Madam, my son has gone out to {{city}} and wants a sign for its first shop. The town, he writes, already speaks of itself as the equal of any in the country. Before I paint, tell me who settles its accounts, so the bill goes to a desk that will pay it.

variants.headline: Settlers depart from {{city}}
body: A group of settlers has departed from {{city}} to find new land, resulting in a population loss of {{lost}}.

variants.headline: Population Drain in {{city}}
body: {{city}} is {{lost}} souls lighter today as another group of settlers departs for the frontier. While the {{terms.civic.government}} praises this expansion, the residents left behind are facing dwindling spirits and growing hardship. {{terms.civic.leaderAddress}}, why are we exporting our youth when the home city is in such visible decline?

variants.headline: Settlers Depart {{city}} for the Frontier
body: {{city}} is {{lost}} souls lighter today as a new party of settlers marched out the main gates to claim fresh land. The {{terms.civic.government}}'s vision for expansion is taking shape, and the mood in the city remains jubilant. Local merchants are already preparing shipments to support the new settlement, confident in the {{terms.civic.leaderTitle}}'s foresight.

variants.headline: One more thing to pack in {{city}}
body: The carts on the east lane of {{city}} stand loaded past the axles, and the count is down by {{lost}}. A woman at the last door is giving away the pots she cannot carry and keeping one lid. Her neighbor, who has taken the hens, asks only that she take the rooster with her.
